messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: Re: Gsoc projects 2017
parts:
Project ideas go here:

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki

specifically:

https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects

If a student wants to propose a project, they should certainly feel free
to propose on on the project table.

To enhance chances for success of such a student-driven project, I would
strongly suggest choosing an existing package in the area of the
proposal and contacting the maintainer or development team for that
package with your proto-proposal. Proposals are more likely to be
accepted if they have had a fair amount of work done on them prior to
GSoC, often including code, but certainly showing a great deal of
thought and planning, especially when the mentors are also new to GSoC.

Regards,

Brian
